title: Chapter 51 Going To The Battlefield In Person
content:
Chapter 51 Going To The Battlefield In Person

On the battlefield, the bugbears still had the upper hand at this time, but the Zerg's victory was due to the constant flow of reinforcements.

Wu Qing no longer allowed a small group of reinforcements to assemble and stand by, but directly joined the battlefield.

Every short period of time, 100 puppies and 5 hydralisks from the Zerg tribe joined the battlefield, while the strength of the Bugbear tribe became smaller and smaller.

The number of Zerg Hydralisks soon increased to 1,200. They occupied a high vantage point. On this chaotic battlefield, when they found that there were many enemies there, they fired volleys at them, without caring whether they would accidentally injure those in the battle. puppy.

As the battle continues, the balance of victory is already tilting towards the Zerg.

The unwilling bugbear priest used two kinds of faith blessings, lucidity and madness, on the bugbear infantry in the melee at all costs.

The large number of bugbear infantrymen in the melee suddenly grew in size and strength. At the same time, they did not lose their minds because of the blessing of sobriety.

The berserk bugbear infantry launched a frantic attack on the puppy. This sudden outbreak pushed the battle line a lot closer to the Hydralisk's position.

"This evil god priest is so willing to give up! A war has used so much blessing. If it were replaced by the luck of the territory, the luck of a large territory would have to be drained!"

Meng seemed to know many secrets, and Wu Qing was not in a hurry to ask, because this did not fit with his and the Zerg's character.

Some things cannot be rushed. The more you come into contact with them, the more slowly you will understand them.

Facing the mad bugbear infantry, the puppies would not fight blindly. They began to take advantage of their body flexibility to try to contain and delay the enemy's offensive.

In fact, no matter how hard they fight against the Zerg, they can win. At worst, the Hydralisks take the initiative to retreat. Wu Qing just habitually uses every advantage to strive for greater benefits.

The berserk bugbear infantry broke out for a while, but when the puppies adjusted their tactics, their offensive fell into fatigue and their advancement speed dropped significantly.

As the Zerg reinforcements continued to join in, the berserk bugbear infantry also fell into a difficult situation.

The Bugbear Priest had tried his best. He looked back at the road and found no sign of his scouts. He knew that the battle situation here was not necessarily clear to the city behind.

He took out a flare and fired the agreed signal into the sky to convey the news that the mission had failed.

"Let's go! Bring back all the detailed information here!"

The bugbear priest glanced in the direction of Wu Qing and Meng expressionlessly, then turned and left with hundreds of escorting knights.

"Hey! It's the first time I've seen an evil god priest who can run away!"

"Wu Qing! We can't let that priest escape! Their status is very special. If we kill them, the luck of our two territories will greatly increase!"

Seeing the bugbear priest leaving, Meng could no longer sit still. As if he understood his mood, the giant tiger mount under him was no longer quiet and looked ready to move.

"The battle was evenly matched on the battlefield, and now we may not be able to stop the sacrifice."

Wu Qing didn't want to let the sacrifice go, but now the Zerg forces were basically contained and there was no extra force to pursue.

There are only a few puppies around who are responsible for reconnaissance. There are not enough of them, and rushing forward will not be of much use.

"Then what are you waiting for! Let's go!"

With these fierce words, the Tiger Cavalry behind him became energetic.

These are a bunch of militants!

"You won't just let us watch here, will you?"

He suddenly raised the sword in his hand, as if waiting for Wu Qing to nod.

Now that Mengdu said this, Wu Qing could only agree. He really did not have the ability to intercept the fleeing bugbear priests alone now.

"Okay! Then we'll do it ourselves!"

Wu Qing seemed to have found the feeling of riding a horse across the battlefield again.

"drive!"

The Zerg war horse that Wu Qing sat on charged forward, leading him down the hillside first.

The biological armor on his body proliferated and changed, turning into a set of pitch-black full-body armor that covered him, and transformed into a dark spear in his hand.

"roar!"

The giant tiger, which had long been unable to hold back after sitting down suddenly, let out a roar and pounced in the direction of the war horse.

"Haha! Warriors! Follow me to kill the enemy!"

Meng laughed and held up his sword, looking very excited.

"kill!"

The tiger cavalry shouted in unison, charging behind Meng with murderous intent, and the momentum was astonishing.

The biological reproductive equipment on the ten insect men changed, and some auxiliary limbs were generated, allowing them to follow Wu Qing's side very quickly.

Because he wanted to pursue the enemy, Wu Qing did not rush into the battlefield, but passed by the edge of the battlefield.

There were lizardmen blocking the way, and the tall war horses rushed past without him needing to take action.

But Meng deliberately rushed to the edge of the battlefield, laughing and slashing with a big knife, just like chopping melons and vegetables, slashing all the way.

The giant tiger under him is also extremely ferocious, pounces and bites, and no enemy can stand in front of it.

The tiger cavalry behind him followed behind and used their swords to make up for the mistakes from time to time, neatly.

Wu Qing looked at these tiger warriors with some helplessness. They were a group of real militants with normal minds.

Under the fierce influence, Wu Qing suddenly had the urge to rush and kill.

He adjusted his direction slightly, and in front of him was a mad bugbear who had just beaten the puppy into nothing.

Although his consciousness was now on the insect clone, he also had a feeling of blood boiling.

As the Zerg master, his consciousness is 100% consistent with any Zerg unit. The body of the specially made Zerg substitute is perfect enough to allow him to exert some strength.

Wu Qing approached the berserker bugbear, and the thick mace in the bugbear's hand smashed down on him.

The long spear in Wu Qing's hand was like a black dragon, circling and piercing the berserker bugbear's neck from an incredible angle.

Under the huge impact of the warhorse, the berserker bugbear's entire head was almost blown off.

The berserker bugbear turned into light and disappeared, and the thick mace lost its support and fell to the ground.

Wu Qing stabbed a few more times, and a berserker bugbear turned into light and left with each shot, and each shot was fatal!

As for the lizardman, he didn't pay any attention to him at all. The warhorse stepped on him with one hoof, and the lizardman couldn't get up.

Meng also noticed Wu Qing's battle, and Wu Qing's magical spearmanship made his eyes bright.

He could see that such spearmanship was refined through countless battles, and Wu Qing's superb spearmanship needed to be tempered through countless actual battles.

This shows that he was not wrong about him.

The enemies killed by Meng and the Tiger Cavalry can also be converted into matter and energy, because the deaths of these people are causally related to Wu Qing.

Meng watched the enemies who fell under his hands turn into light and disappear, and the image of Wu Qing and the Zerg in his mind became more mysterious.

Since this was the edge of the battlefield and there were puppies fighting, there were not many enemies in front of Wu Qing and Meng.

A group of fierce knights rushed through the edge of the battlefield, and all the enemies in front of them turned into light and disappeared.

Rushing through the battlefield, in front of them was the fleeing bear goblin priest and the cavalry team led by him.
